degree.text: Degree Awarded Master Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objective After the course you will be expertise in electrified transmission and power system operation, automatic control, power electronics, information processing, experimental analysis, product development, technological management, the use of professional software and some electrical engineering related areas. Main Courses Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Circuit Analysis, Foundation of Electrical Machinery & Towage, Analog Electronic Technology, Digital Electronic Technology, Principle of Automatic Control, Electrical Power Engineering, Principle of , Power Electronics, Electrical Power Towage Automatic Control System. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Master Degree of Engineering. Career Graduates can be comprehensive talents to make research in the electrical field, maintain and control system in the enterprise, develop new device in the electrical institute or make teaching in the university.

duration.text: The Physical Electronics at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Undergraduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of Undergraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Bachelor's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
